decisions.reason: As a modular extension for machine-tool fluid management, the minimum quantity lubrication system is still a plausible option to keep open because it fits the firm's engineering base and likely costs relatively little to continue offering despite some remaining market uncertainty.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter is close to the firm's core filtration business, so in an expanding firm with in-house R&D and modular production there is little reason to abandon it unless results were clearly weak.

The gravity band coolant filter appears to be a standard, highly complementary product within the firm's established coolant filtration range, making continued offering the most likely choice under real options logic.
